Here are some nouns that have three letters or fewer with at least two identical letters:

**Two-letter nouns:**
- AA (type of lava)
- EE (archaic form of "eye")
- OO (type of Hawaiian bird)

**Three-letter nouns:**
- AAH (exclamation)
- ADD (attention deficit disorder)
- AGG (aggression, informal)
- ALL (everything)
- ASS (donkey)
- BEE (insect)
- BOO (ghost sound)
- DAD (father)
- EEL (fish)
- EGG (oval reproductive body)
- ELL (wing of a building)
- ERR (mistake)
- EYE (organ of sight)
- FEE (payment)
- GOO (sticky substance)
- ILL (sickness)
- INN (small hotel)
- MOM (mother)
- NUN (religious woman)
- ODD (strange thing)
- OFF (insect repellent)
- PEE (urine)
- POP (father/soda)
- PUP (young dog)
- SEE (diocese)
- SIS (sister)
- TAT (lace)
- TEE (golf peg)
- TOO (also)
- WOO (courtship)
- ZOO (animal park)

These nouns all contain at least one letter that appears twice within their spelling.
